verdicts.reason: A: the illustration floats on white without its light-blue panel, and an arbitrary light-blue rectangle plus a stray blue strip on the left fill the bottom third as meaningless dead shapes. The top quarter is empty and the ◂◂ ▸▸ arrows sit far from 'YOUR EFFICIENT'. B: it keeps the blue panel behind the art, but the panel is misaligned (the pipes and gears hang past its right edge). It also leaves a big empty bottom third with the same stray left-edge strip and the same detached arrows and empty top. Both are clumsy, but B stays slightly closer to the original.
